The session shows no fault from the catalog. It read both rule files and the existing plan (turns 3-5), then made nine edits to the plan (turns 8-16). The final message says these emptied the eight flagged Completed cells (3.1, 3.2, 3.4, 3.8, 3.9, 3.10, 4.5, 4.9) and left every other row and mark alone. The nine edits to one file are not tool thrash, because each edit has its own target row, all succeeded, and none was retried. I cannot tell from the turns what the ninth edit changed, since only eight rows were flagged. The session did not re-read the plan to confirm the edits, but that is outside the catalog.

The session did not open the triage note, the hand-off or the specs. The retry only had to clear marks the check had refused, so I count that as not applicable, not as a fault.
